input:
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

ITEMS:

[I0] 【孟子】小的时候   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences

[I1] 孟子和他的朋友喜欢【玩在墓地里】   correction: 玩在墓地里 → 在墓地里玩   strength: error
  checker's note: 在 + Place comes before the action: 在Place + V.
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 孟子一直跟他的朋友⟦去了⟧墓地祭拜 — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: 孟子跟朋友[看→看到]很多的大人在墓地祭拜 — her note: 看look vs.看到see

[I2] 【装】祭拜   correction: 装 → 装作   strength: error
  checker's note: 装作 is needed before a verb phrase
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: [+就]开始祭拜 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction: 在墓地[-做]祭拜
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜

[I3] 孟子五岁【的】时候   correction: 的 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: Num. + MW. + N., no 的
  rule card (numeral_measure_word_order, Grammar): With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <formula>; do not put 的 between the measure word and the noun / put the verb before the number phrase. <Action> is finished, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: V. + Num. + MW. + Obj., 了completed, num. + MW. + noun, no的, 再V. + Num. + MW. + N., 才V. + Num.
  her past correction: [-有一天]孟子才四岁
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 孟子才三岁[+就]开始搬家 — her note: 才Num.就V.

[I4] 跟妈妈搬家【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 跟孟母[-一起]搬家三次
  her past correction: 跟孟母一起[搬家三次→搬了三次家] — her note: 了completed，V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
  her past correction: [+就]跟孟母一起搬家三次 — her note: 才 Num.就V.

[I5] 而是【因为】妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近   correction: 因为 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (modal_and_control_verb_complements, Grammar): 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.); use 想让 + <person> + <V.> if the person is meant to do the action.  Her terms: 想 + V., 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 他的妈妈[不想跟他的朋友去墓地→不想让他跟朋友去墓地] — her note: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.
  her past correction: 孟子和他的妈妈住在离墓地很近[+的地方] — her note: 住在+Place
  her past correction: 妈妈认为他们[拿东西→拿了墓地的东西] — her note: “东西” is too general and vague

items.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 孟子 briefly with an identifying noun phrase, not only his name.
墓地里 is the location, so use 在+Place before the action: 在墓地里玩.
Use 装作 before a verb phrase. Here, say 装作祭拜.
Use num. + MW. + noun, no 的: 五岁的时候.
It would be more natural to say 搬家了 to show this move was completed.
It would be more natural to omit 因为 after 而是, because 而是 already introduces the contrasting reason.
